variableDeclarations.name: account_id
variableDeclarations.description: Account found by lookup_account. Empty until the caller is identified.

variableDeclarations.name: phone_last4
variableDeclarations.description: Last 4 digits of the accounts phone number; safe to say aloud.

variableDeclarations.name: caller_provided_phone_last4
variableDeclarations.description: Last 4 digits of the phone number the caller actually gave on this call.

variableDeclarations.name: auth_status
variableDeclarations.description: Login progress: none, code_sent, pass or locked. Only check_login_code or check_secret_pin sets pass.

variableDeclarations.name: login_code_sent
variableDeclarations.description: True once send_login_code has sent a code on the active account.

variableDeclarations.name: logged_in
variableDeclarations.description: True once caller has successfully verified login authentication.

variableDeclarations.name: auth_failure_count
variableDeclarations.description: Number of failed authentication attempts in current session.

variableDeclarations.name: login_attempts
variableDeclarations.description: Counter of SMS/code login validation attempts.

variableDeclarations.name: pin_failure_count
variableDeclarations.description: Count of invalid PIN entries.

variableDeclarations.name: pin_attempts
variableDeclarations.description: Counter of secret PIN validation attempts.

variableDeclarations.name: payment_failure_count
variableDeclarations.description: Count of failed or declined payment attempts.

variableDeclarations.name: card_last4
variableDeclarations.description: Last 4 digits of primary payment card on file.

variableDeclarations.name: card_token
variableDeclarations.description: Masked payment card token for enrolled card.

variableDeclarations.name: card_capture_prompted
variableDeclarations.description: True when caller has been prompted to enter card digits on keypad.

variableDeclarations.name: preamble_spoken
variableDeclarations.description: True when PCI payment method preamble has been spoken in session.

variableDeclarations.name: pending_card_last4
variableDeclarations.description: Caller-stated last 4 digits of card awaiting keypad capture.

variableDeclarations.name: declined_card_last4
variableDeclarations.description: Last 4 digits of card that was declined.

variableDeclarations.name: payment_declined_once
variableDeclarations.description: True if payment attempt was declined at least once.

variableDeclarations.name: last_payment_method
variableDeclarations.description: Last payment method used (card, bank, autopay).

variableDeclarations.name: mock_error
variableDeclarations.description: Injected test mock error condition code.

variableDeclarations.name: language
variableDeclarations.description: Session language code (en-US, fr-CA, es-US).

variableDeclarations.name: preferred_language
variableDeclarations.description: Subscribers preferred language on file.

variableDeclarations.name: preferred_mfa_channel
variableDeclarations.description: Subscribers active MFA delivery channel (sms, email, or authenticator_app).

variableDeclarations.name: lookup_by_name
variableDeclarations.description: True when caller account was identified via caller name lookup.

variableDeclarations.name: last_user_utterance
variableDeclarations.description: Verbatim transcript of most recent caller utterance.

variableDeclarations.name: handoff_reason
variableDeclarations.description: Machine-readable reason for agent handover.

variableDeclarations.name: handoff_status
variableDeclarations.description: Current status of agent escalation handoff.

variableDeclarations.name: handover_complete
variableDeclarations.description: True if transfer to live human agent is completed.

variableDeclarations.name: handoff_message
variableDeclarations.description: Summary context passed to human agent queue.

variableDeclarations.name: last_tracking_id
variableDeclarations.description: Tracking identifier for hardware shipment or order.

variableDeclarations.name: request_summary
variableDeclarations.description: Summary of user inquiry or submitted transaction.

variableDeclarations.name: active_appointment_id
variableDeclarations.description: ID of currently scheduled technician or store appointment.

variableDeclarations.name: after_hours
variableDeclarations.description: True if call is received outside standard support hours.

variableDeclarations.name: appointment_cancel_confirmed
variableDeclarations.description: True if caller confirmed appointment cancellation.

variableDeclarations.name: appointment_status
variableDeclarations.description: Status of service appointment (e.g. SCHEDULED, CANCELLED).

variableDeclarations.name: audit_log_count
variableDeclarations.description: Count of audit events logged in session.

variableDeclarations.name: autopay_day
variableDeclarations.description: Day of month for automatic recurring billing.

variableDeclarations.name: autopay_enrolled
variableDeclarations.description: True if account is enrolled in AutoPay.

variableDeclarations.name: bank_last4
variableDeclarations.description: Last 4 digits of bank account used for payments.

variableDeclarations.name: business_flag
variableDeclarations.description: True if account belongs to business tier.

variableDeclarations.name: cancellation_fee_disclosed
variableDeclarations.description: True if cancellation fee disclosure was acknowledged.

variableDeclarations.name: contact_email
variableDeclarations.description: Subscribers primary contact email.

variableDeclarations.name: current_balance
variableDeclarations.description: Current total account balance in dollars.

variableDeclarations.name: customer_type
variableDeclarations.description: Type of customer: residential or business.

variableDeclarations.name: dispute_ticket_id
variableDeclarations.description: Ticket ID for billing dispute or waiver.

variableDeclarations.name: identified
variableDeclarations.description: True once subscriber account has been identified.

variableDeclarations.name: is_blocked
variableDeclarations.description: True if caller or account is blocked for fraud/abuse.

variableDeclarations.name: is_suspended
variableDeclarations.description: True if service is currently suspended.

variableDeclarations.name: last_order_id
variableDeclarations.description: ID of last order placed.

variableDeclarations.name: login_channel
variableDeclarations.description: Channel used for login authentication verification.

variableDeclarations.name: lost_authenticator
variableDeclarations.description: True if subscriber lost their MFA authenticator.

variableDeclarations.name: mfa_email_code_sent
variableDeclarations.description: True if MFA code was sent via email.

variableDeclarations.name: mfa_email_verified
variableDeclarations.description: True if MFA code from email was verified.

variableDeclarations.name: mfa_enabled
variableDeclarations.description: True if MFA is enabled on the account.

variableDeclarations.name: outage_active
variableDeclarations.description: True if there is an active network outage in the area.

variableDeclarations.name: outage_sms_subscribed
variableDeclarations.description: True if caller subscribed to outage SMS alerts.

variableDeclarations.name: password_reset_sent
variableDeclarations.description: True if password reset notification was sent.

variableDeclarations.name: past_due_balance
variableDeclarations.description: Overdue balance amount in dollars.

variableDeclarations.name: payment_arrangement_active
variableDeclarations.description: True if an active payment arrangement exists.

variableDeclarations.name: payment_arrangement_due_date
variableDeclarations.description: Agreed due date for payment arrangement installment.

variableDeclarations.name: port_in_request_id
variableDeclarations.description: Ticket ID for telephone number port-in request.

variableDeclarations.name: postal_code
variableDeclarations.description: Postal code for service location.

variableDeclarations.name: refund_applied_amount
variableDeclarations.description: Amount credited or refunded in dollars.

variableDeclarations.name: regional_alert
variableDeclarations.description: Active regional alert or weather advisory text.

variableDeclarations.name: selected_plan_id
variableDeclarations.description: Identifier of selected plan during change_plan.

variableDeclarations.name: service_address
variableDeclarations.description: Physical installation address for telecom service.

variableDeclarations.name: service_cancelled
variableDeclarations.description: True if service cancellation was completed.

variableDeclarations.name: service_restored
variableDeclarations.description: True if suspended service was restored.

variableDeclarations.name: browsed_plan_category
variableDeclarations.description: Plan category most recently browsed during sales flows.

variableDeclarations.name: shortlisted_plan_ids
variableDeclarations.description: Comma-separated list of plan IDs shortlisted.

variableDeclarations.name: suspension_reason
variableDeclarations.description: Reason given for account suspension.

variableDeclarations.name: technician_status
variableDeclarations.description: Dispatch status of technician appointment.

variableDeclarations.name: troubleshooting_sms_sent
variableDeclarations.description: True if automated troubleshooting guide SMS was sent.

variableDeclarations.name: troubleshooting_sms_attempts
variableDeclarations.description: Counter of troubleshooting SMS dispatch attempts.

variableDeclarations.name: tv_sub_type
variableDeclarations.description: Current television package tier.

variableDeclarations.name: warranty_claim_id
variableDeclarations.description: Identifier for hardware warranty claim.

variableDeclarations.name: warranty_damage_checked
variableDeclarations.description: True if physical damage assessment was completed.

variableDeclarations.name: local_noinput_counter
variableDeclarations.description: Consecutive turns with no caller input detected.

variableDeclarations.name: no_match_confirmation_count
variableDeclarations.description: Consecutive turns with unmatchable caller input.

variableDeclarations.name: global_err_count
variableDeclarations.description: Total cumulative errors in session.
